## 3. Detailed Services Portfolio
### 3.1 Solar Energy Solutions (Rooftop & Utility EPC)
- Engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), and O&M for rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations.
- Residential Rooftop: 1 kW to 15 kW grid-tied systems designed for homes, row houses, and apartments.
- Commercial & Institutional: 20 kW to 500 kW arrays for schools, hospitals, IT parks, colleges, and hotels.
- Industrial Megawatt Plants: 500 kW to 10+ MW captive power setups for factories in Mandideep, Govindpura, Pithampur industrial corridors.
- Discom Interconnection: Coordination with MPMKVVCL (Madhya Pradesh Central Discom) for bi-directional net-metering.

### 3.2 Wind Energy Systems
- Micro-wind and utility-scale turbine installation and wind resource assessment.
- Hybrid wind-solar installations to provide complementary generation cycles (wind generation during evening/night peaks, solar during daytime peak).

### 3.3 Geothermal Energy Solutions
- Exploiting subterranean earth heat reservoirs using closed-loop ground-source heat pump (GSHP) and direct geothermal generation systems for continuous 24/7/365 baseload clean power.

### 3.4 Biomass & Biogas Infrastructure
- Converting agricultural residues, bovine waste, and municipal solid organics into combustible biogas (methane) and purified bio-CNG.
- Installation of continuous stirred-tank reactors (CSTR) and high-rate anaerobic digesters.

### 3.5 Energy Storage & Microgrids (BESS)
- Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) battery energy storage systems (BESS).
- Uninterrupted power supply with intelligent battery management systems (BMS), high depth-of-discharge (90%), and over 6,000 thermal cycles.

### 3.6 IoT Automation & Smart Monitoring
- Remote telemetry systems measuring solar irradiance, temperature-adjusted PR (Performance Ratio), string current, inverter telemetry, and alerting degradation or shading faults via mobile/cloud dashboards.

## 4. Government Subsidies & Schemes (Bhopal & Madhya Pradesh)
- **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana**:
  - Direct benefit transfer (DBT) to the homeowner's bank account.
  - Up to 1 kW: ₹30,000 subsidy.
  - 2 kW: ₹60,000 subsidy.
  - 3 kW to 10 kW: ₹78,000 maximum central subsidy.
  - Payback period in Bhopal: Between 3.2 to 4.5 years with substantial electricity bill reductions.
